decision.basis: User-directed pretraining readiness repairs and continuation; hy4 explicitly deferred by user. Current code/source/array checks and actual-model finite forward/backward smoke passed. This is a machine-reviewed scoped release, not independent model or scientific validation.
requirements: Fresh model initialization; never load legacy checkpoints
Train fold only for optimizer; validation for model selection; calibration and test remain held out
External primary receptor registry remains excluded
Use CPU on current host; no assumption of CUDA support or adequate GPU memory
Report synthetic-decoy task metrics only; do not call these binding, cross-reactivity or clinical accuracy
Store logs/config/checkpoints in a new run directory; never overwrite release or historical results
scientific_limitations: No ground truth negative status established for synthetic decoys
External SPR pairs lack validated consistent-pipeline predicted structures
External panel is case-selected and does not validate clinical/general population performance
